title: Verger
description: A match-3 orchard in broad daylight. Swap two neighbouring fruits to line up three or more of a kind; harvests cascade as the canopy falls and regrows. Twelve orchards, each with a basket to fill before the moves run out — apples, pears, plums, cherries or any fruit — tuned by simulation so the difficulty climbs from first picking to the great orchard. Lush green palette, touch-first, in English, French and Spanish.
controls: Tap a fruit, then a neighbouring one — or drag one onto its neighbour — to swap them.
A swap must line up three or more identical fruits in a row or column; otherwise the branch refuses and no move is spent.
Fill the basket shown at the top before the moves run out; finish with moves to spare for brighter stars.
credits: A game by Cédric Bernadac, created with AI agents (ZCode).
